verdict.rationale: Buzz documents an open wire protocol: third-party clients connect directly to buzz-relay over NIP-29 with NIP-42 auth, and there is a feature-status table covering group chat and reactions. It also documents a signed-event /api/admin/v1 HTTP API for moderation, and the relay is described as serving REST. However, the documented protocol surface shown covers mainly chat, admin is limited to moderation, and probes found no OpenAPI or other general REST API reference. missing for 10: documented API coverage of repos/workflows/canvases (currently CLI-only in evidence), a published OpenAPI/REST reference, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API
